meta.note: 업로드된 교재 p.112와 정답·해설 p.82의 대표 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 웹앱 상호작용으로 변환함.

items.sentence: However unnoticeably, maps reflect the world views of either their makers or, more probably, the supporters of their makers, in addition to the political and social conditions under which they were made.
items.prompt: either A or B가 연결하는 두 명사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: either A or B에서 A는 their makers, B는 the supporters of their makers입니다. more probably는 B 앞에 삽입된 부사구입니다.
items.memory: 첫 짝을 발견하면 삽입어구를 건너뛰고 대응하는 두 번째 짝을 찾기

items.sentence: In medieval diplomacy, the relations of countries and rulers depended not at all on common borders or natural interest but on dynastic connections and distant cousinships.
items.prompt: not A but B가 대조하는 A와 B를 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: not A but B는 ‘A가 아니라 B’입니다. not 뒤의 at all은 부정을 강조합니다.

items.sentence: In medieval diplomacy, the relations of countries and rulers depended not at all on common borders or natural interest but on dynastic connections and distant cousinships.
items.prompt: ‘the skill of creating friendly relationships between countries’에 해당하는 문장 속 단어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: diplomacy는 국가 간의 우호적 관계를 형성·관리하는 ‘외교’를 뜻합니다.

items.sentence: Most analysts agree that it is fair that the burden of payment of the greenhouse problem should fall most heavily on the world's richest countries, which are not only in the best position to pay but have also been, historically, the main cause of the problem.
items.prompt: it is fair에서 it을 대신하는 진주어 that절을 드래그하세요.
items.answer: that the burden of payment of the greenhouse problem should fall most heavily on the world's richest countries
items.explanation: agree의 목적어 that절 안에서 it은 가주어이고, 뒤의 that the burden ... countries가 진주어입니다.
